baseline_models.mechanism: The settled places preserve a readable trace of an absent collective, making discernment spatial, retrospective, and evidentiary.

activation_trace.role: The clarity sense makes the dwellings readable evidence rather than scenery.
The stable-place sense supplies a material register in which the absent people remain legible.
The inward-discernment sense turns observing the site into accountable recognition.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that their dwellings reveal what happened.
changed_reading.after: The dwelling is an active diagnostic surface through which the absent community becomes readable to the present observer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ
baseline_models.mechanism: An adversarial beautifier recodes deliberate works as attractive, then converts attraction into directional diversion despite retained insight.

activation_trace.role: The improving action supplies the attractive surface placed over the works.
The intentional-action sense makes the objects of attraction chosen practices.
The rebellious-agent sense gives the beautifier an active adversarial role.
The turning-away sense supplies the directional consequence of the attractive recoding.
The traversable-route sense measures the loss as separation from a usable way.
The insight sense preserves the paradox that diversion need not begin with ignorance.

changed_reading.before: Satan deceives them by making bad deeds look good.
changed_reading.after: The focus depicts a valuation trap in which purposeful works become an appealing route and redirect people who still possess insight.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus separates external clarity and internal discernment from the evaluative orientation that governs action: seeing and knowing remain present while valuation is displaced.

activation_trace.role: The disclosure sense establishes that the evidence is available to view.
The eye-sense permits alert observation of what is materially present.
The heart-sense permits inward recognition without guaranteeing right orientation.
The beautifying action shows how appearance can interfere with evaluation.
The diversion sense shows cognition issuing in the wrong direction.

changed_reading.before: They were intelligent but somehow fooled.
changed_reading.after: The focus distinguishes available evidence and possible insight from the failure to let either govern valuation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening test reframes the focus's discernment as a capacity exposed by conduct rather than a settled excuse.

activation_trace.role: The focus insight sense supplies the capacity whose adequacy is now tested.
The testing image makes pressure a sorting operation that exposes what is genuine.
The knowledge image makes the hidden distinction between truthful and false claim manifest.
The truth-through-action image lets subsequent conduct ratify an earlier claim.

structural_cues: The opening asks whether people are left untested, then repeats emphatic knowing around truthful and false claimants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, disclosure, and conduct-marked truth; I infer that the focus names discernment under moral trial; an alternative is merely perceptual or worldly intelligence.

changed_reading.before: Discernment is a possession they already have.
changed_reading.after: Discernment is a tested capacity whose failure concerns what insight proves in action, not whether information was available.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context turns works into accountable acts whose apparent attractiveness is later contradicted or confirmed by repair and recompense.

activation_trace.role: The focus action sense makes their works chosen and consequential.
The focus beautification sense supplies the attractive presentation that can mask consequence.
The repeated work sense makes deeds the explicit object of moral assessment.
The soundness image supplies the norm against which actions are repaired or corrupted.
The recompense image makes an act return as a corresponding result.

structural_cues: The sequence contrasts bad actions with sound actions, covering faults and rewarding the best of what was done.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate works, reform, covering, and recompense; I infer that focus beautification is a provisional valuation later re-read by consequence; an alternative is general moral bookkeeping without a specific link to Satanic redirection.

changed_reading.before: Their works are simply whatever they did.
changed_reading.after: Their works form a moral ledger whose attractive surface can be overturned by later evaluation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Social pain and anticipated relief make commitment performative, allowing beautification to function as adaptive camouflage.

activation_trace.role: The focus improving action supplies the recoding of a choice under pressure.
The focus deliberate-action sense makes the recoded commitment behaviorally visible.
The harm image supplies the pressure that can make a person reinterpret allegiance.
The ordeal image frames that pressure as a revealing stress condition.
The hidden-contradiction image makes public appearance and private allegiance diverge.

structural_cues: Conditional pain and aid produce opposite claims, followed immediately by the naming of hypocrites.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harm, trial, concealed contradiction, and reversal; I infer that pressure can cause works to be socially beautified and affiliation to switch; an alternative is ordinary hypocrisy without an adversarial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Beautification is a general temptation.
changed_reading.after: Beautification can be survival-facing social camouflage: pain makes the compromised choice seem necessary and relief restores affiliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The barred path becomes socially transmissible: a claimed route recruits followers and distributes, rather than removes, responsibility.

activation_trace.role: The focus turning-away sense supplies active redirection.
The focus route sense supplies the shared way being entered or lost.
The following image supplies recruitment into another person's route.
The path image turns the invitation into a traversable social direction.
The burden-bearing image assigns responsibility for what one carries onward.
The heaviness image makes accumulated liability materially felt.

structural_cues: A direct command to follow a path is followed by a false promise to carry others' faults, then by the addition of extra burdens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, route, and carrying; I infer that social imitation is the causal channel of obstruction and compounded liability; an alternative is that the path remains solely an individual's inward moral direction.

changed_reading.before: Being barred from the path is a private spiritual deviation.
changed_reading.after: The blockage is socially transmitted through recruited followers and leaves the recruiter carrying compounded consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: Catastrophe erases occupants while preserving a public memory regime in which places and survivors become signs.

activation_trace.role: The focus place sense supplies the material site that can outlast its inhabitants.
The focus clarity sense makes the surviving site readable.
The engulfing-water image supplies a force that overwrites an established settlement.
The vessel image supplies a contrasting vehicle of survival through the same watery space.
The sign image converts survival and loss into a public clue for later observers.

structural_cues: Long residence is followed by flood, rescue in a vessel, and the making of that event into a sign for all worlds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flood, vessel, survival, and sign; I infer that dwelling-based clarity includes disaster memory carried by landscapes; an alternative is that the sign is only a miraculous event, not an architectural trace.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings simply prove that an earlier people existed.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings are residues of an overwrite: occupants vanish, but the site remains as public disaster memory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel, observation, and return make the dwelling an empirical station in a recurring pattern rather than a static illustration.

activation_trace.role: The focus disclosure sense supplies the legibility sought by observation.
The focus stable-place sense supplies a site through which history can be inspected.
The return image links beginning and restoration into a repeatable temporal pattern.
The travel image turns the land into a route of inquiry.
The inspection image makes looking an act of examination rather than passive viewing.
The beginning image supplies the comparison between first formation and later return.

structural_cues: Questions about how creation begins and returns are followed by an instruction to travel the earth and inspect it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, travel, looking, and beginning; I infer that the focus dwelling becomes field evidence in a method of historical comparison; an alternative is a purely cosmological reflection on creation.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings prove a past event.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings become field evidence: travel, inspect what remains, and infer a pattern of beginning and return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Shared affection gives collective works their moral shine, while the same network later reverses into reciprocal disavowal.

activation_trace.role: The household sense embeds the focus works in a shared social unit.
The adornment sense makes the works socially valued objects.
The affection image supplies the warmth that can make a collective practice seem unquestionably good.
The relational-between image makes shared attachment the connective medium of the works.
The disavowal image shows the same social bond reversing under final accountability.

structural_cues: Affection is explicitly located in worldly life and is followed by mutual rejection and cursing on the later day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies affection, relation, and later disavowal; I infer that social attachment is one medium through which works are beautified; an alternative is that the focus concerns individual works independent of group belonging.

changed_reading.before: The beautifier acts on an individual's perception of deeds.
changed_reading.after: The social bond itself can lend deeds their shine, then become a chain of reciprocal disavowal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's abstract redirection is sharpened into public route denial: a path can be obstructed where people travel and gather.

activation_trace.role: The deviation sense gives the adversarial action a vector of misalignment.
The focus repelling sense supplies active obstruction.
The focus route sense supplies a public way that can be denied.
The road-blocking image supplies forceful interference with travelers.
The traversable-way image makes the blocked route spatially concrete.

structural_cues: The Lot episode names cutting the path between other public acts and responds by demanding punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies route-cutting and a path; I infer that the focus obstruction has a collective access dimension; an alternative is that the path remains an abstract synonym for guidance.

changed_reading.before: Satan turns people away from an inward moral path.
changed_reading.after: The focus can also describe public route denial that prevents people from moving toward the right way.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dwelling-root becomes social: residence and household belonging are not identical, because moral alignment determines who is inside the rescued unit.

activation_trace.role: The household sense lets the focus place include its people and relations.
The belonging image defines a dwelling through a circle of kin and affiliation.
The woman/person image isolates an individual relation within the household boundary.
The remaining-behind image marks exclusion from the protected unit.

structural_cues: Lot and his household are promised rescue, but his wife is explicitly excluded and counted among those left behind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selective rescue and household relation; I infer that the focus's dwelling can foreground belonging as well as walls; an alternative is that the phrase means only physical buildings and the household split is separate.

changed_reading.before: Their dwellings are architectural sites.
changed_reading.after: Their dwelling is also a membership boundary, and residence does not guarantee alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dwelling becomes the hinge between movement and stasis: a trace is left behind, then bodies are seized and fixed at home.

activation_trace.role: The focus clarity sense makes the residue readable.
The focus site-of-stability sense supplies the place where the residue remains.
The left-behind image makes an aftermath persist after the people have gone.
The sign image converts persistence into a visible lesson.
The contextual clarity image confirms that the remnant can be recognized.
The violent-shaking image supplies the event that arrests ordinary habitation.
The ground-fixed-body image turns the home into the scene of final immobilization.

structural_cues: A clear sign is left from the place, then the quake takes the people and leaves them grounded in their houses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies retained sign, shaking, and fixed bodies; I infer a causal bridge from diverted movement to material stasis; an alternative is that the two episodes are merely adjacent punishment narratives.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings testify after destruction.
changed_reading.after: The dwelling is where motion ends and the diverted community becomes a fixed warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context redistributes agency: an external lure explains redirection, but arrogance and chosen works make the consequence just and inescapable.

activation_trace.role: The focus intentional-action sense locates consequence in what the people themselves do.
The focus obstruction sense supplies the initial route diversion.
The arrogance image supplies self-elevation as a motive for rejecting correction.
The escape image denies that power or position can outrun consequence.
The accountability image links taking to the sin that occasioned it.
The self-image locates the final wronging in the agents rather than an external victim.

structural_cues: The sequence joins arrogance, failure to escape, being taken for sin, and the denial that God wronged them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrogance, non-escape, punishment for sin, and self-wronging; I infer a causal division between lure and responsibility; an alternative is divine judgment without a psychological account of how the lure worked.

changed_reading.before: Satan bears the explanatory weight for their diversion.
changed_reading.after: Satan explains the lure, but their own beautified works make the consequence just and unavoidable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A self-made structure can look coherent enough to inhabit while lacking the strength to protect, explaining how beautification stops departure.

activation_trace.role: The focus stable-place sense supplies the shelter function.
The focus beautifying action supplies apparent attractiveness and coherence.
The focus work sense makes the shelter a constructed human arrangement.
The weaving image supplies a delicate self-produced network.
The house image supplies the protective residence analogy.
The weakness image removes the structure's supposed load-bearing security.

structural_cues: The explicit simile calls the self-made house the weakest of houses and asks whether its makers know.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a woven house and its weakness; I infer that beautified works can feel protective enough to block departure; an alternative is that the simile targets false allies only, without extending to the focus's dwellings.

changed_reading.before: Beautification makes wrong works look pleasant.
changed_reading.after: Beautification can make a weak self-built refuge feel habitable and safe enough to prevent escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies an interruptive practice that connects knowledge to restraint, providing the missing brake against attractive misdirection.

activation_trace.role: The focus work sense makes reorientation a matter of enacted practice.
The focus insight sense supplies knowledge that must be embodied.
The prayer image supplies a repeated embodied discipline.
The restraint image gives that discipline a direct blocking function.
The remembrance image keeps the governing reference present during action.
The chest image locates signs inside the person rather than only in external objects.
The knowledge image confirms that internal evidence is available to its bearers.

structural_cues: Prayer is said to restrain indecency and wrong, remembrance is greater, and signs are located within knowing hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies practice, restraint, remembrance, and internal signs; I infer that the antidote to beautification is an interruptive practice linking insight to conduct; an alternative is that the prayer passage is only a separate ritual exhortation.

changed_reading.before: Their discernment failed despite knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The missing protective operation is practiced inhibition that interrupts what appearance has made attractive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Route loss can progress into total enclosure: the wrong direction first appears chosen, then no unblocked direction remains.

activation_trace.role: The focus repelling sense supplies the initial loss of direction.
The focus route sense supplies the possibility of exit and movement.
The encompassing-glo​bal-force image supplies domination that leaves no external opening.
The covering image turns punishment into something that closes over the person.
The upper-direction image supplies one vertical side of the enclosure.
The lower-direction image supplies the opposite side and removes a remaining escape axis.

structural_cues: Delayed punishment arrives suddenly, is described as encompassing, and then presses from above and below.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure and vertical closure; I infer that being barred can culminate in loss of all exits; an alternative is to retain the above-and-below language as independent eschatological geography.

changed_reading.before: The people are turned from one path.
changed_reading.after: The initial wrong turn can become a condition of total spatial capture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context contrasts inherited settlement with relocatable refuge: leaving a compromised place can reopen orientation, while a received dwelling models stable belonging.

activation_trace.role: The habitation sense supplies the inherited-place problem.
The path sense makes relocation relevant to renewed direction.
The migration image supplies departure from one home toward another.
The earth image opens the physical field beyond one inherited settlement.
The spaciousness image turns the earth into available moral room.
The assigned-place image supplies a prepared refuge rather than an inherited claim.
The elevated-room image gives stable dwelling a protected and ordered form.

structural_cues: Migration is followed by the declaration that the earth is wide and by a promise of prepared rooms with enduring life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies departure, spacious earth, prepared placement, and rooms; I infer that dwelling is morally reconfigurable and need not mean ancestral attachment; an alternative is to restrict the later housing imagery to afterlife reward.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts the path with fixed inherited homes.
changed_reading.after: A compromised settlement can be left, and a received refuge can reopen the path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus path acquires a provisioning dimension: diversion can be pictured as losing access to the water and rescue channels that sustain settlement.

activation_trace.role: The focus blocking sense supplies interruption of access.
The waterward route sense gives the focus path a provisioning function.
The sustenance-at-stay sense links settlement to what keeps inhabitants in place.
The rain-as-provision image supplies water as a life-supporting gift.
The appearing-water image supplies flow entering and reviving the terrestrial system.
The vessel image supplies a concrete route through dangerous water toward rescue.

structural_cues: The later sequence repeatedly joins sustenance, rain, revived earth, ship travel, rescue, and return to land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a water-route branch in the focus and repeated water, provision, and rescue cues; I infer that moral diversion can be imaged as blocked access to life-support; an alternative is the standard ethical meaning of path.

changed_reading.before: The barred path is only a route of guidance.
changed_reading.after: The barred path can also be an interrupted channel to provision, ecological renewal, and rescue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Correct recognition of cosmic facts does not itself govern direction; distraction can separate acknowledgment from path-producing action.

activation_trace.role: The eye-sense preserves the possibility of accurate recognition.
The inward-knowledge sense preserves the possibility of deeper understanding.
The focus beautification sense supplies the mechanism that can redirect valuation.
The creation image supplies an explicit correct acknowledgment of divine making.
The turning-away image shows correct acknowledgment failing to determine orientation.
The revived-earth image supplies another recognized sign of sustaining agency.
The reasoning image makes the missing integration an explicit cognitive failure.
The distraction image supplies an alternative object that occupies attention.

structural_cues: They identify the Creator and the giver of rain, yet the text asks how they are turned away and says most do not reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accurate acknowledgment, turning away, distraction, and failure to reason; I infer that focus discernment can be factually correct but path-inert; an alternative is that the focus word denotes only clear perception, not moral integration.

changed_reading.before: Discernment should have prevented their diversion.
changed_reading.after: The focus separates factual recognition from the insight that actually governs direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Danger strips away the beautified arrangement and produces exclusive reliance, but rescue restores the old social and devotional pattern.

activation_trace.role: The focus adornment sense supplies the condition that can return when circumstances become pleasant.
The focus work sense supplies the practices resumed after rescue.
The vessel-riding image supplies the danger state that strips away ordinary control.
The purification image narrows allegiance during crisis.
The obedience image makes exclusive devotion behaviorally explicit.
The rescue-by-separation image supplies the transition out of danger.
The partnership image names the reappearance of divided allegiance on land.
The grace-concealment image marks denial of what was just received.
The enjoyment image supplies the comfortable state in which the old pattern becomes attractive again.

structural_cues: The conditional sequence moves from ship danger and exclusive devotion to rescue on land, divided worship, denial, and enjoyment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a state reversal between sea and land; I infer that safety itself reactivates beautified works; an alternative is static hypocrisy without a circumstance-sensitive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Their misdirection is a one-time past choice.
changed_reading.after: The valuation trap is state-sensitive: danger removes the decoration, while rescue restores it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A protected settlement can be visible evidence of grace while simultaneously beautifying false self-sufficiency and misattribution.

activation_trace.role: The focus place-of-stability sense supplies the enclave whose safety can be interpreted.
The focus improving sense supplies the attractive appearance of secure normality.
The focus insight sense keeps visible protection available for recognition.
The sanctuary image supplies a spatial exception of safety.
The snatching image supplies the surrounding contrast that makes the exception observable.
The surrounding-direction image turns safety into a bounded enclave.
The falsehood image supplies the mistaken object of trust.
The blessing image supplies the grace that should have been recognized.
The denial-of-grace image shows protection being hidden rather than acknowledged.

structural_cues: A safe sanctuary is contrasted with people being seized around it, followed by questions about believing falsehood and denying blessing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exceptional safety, surrounding danger, false belief, and denied blessing; I infer that secure habitation can make dependence look self-generated; an alternative is a simpler rebuke for ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: Dwellings are clear evidence of what happened to earlier peoples.
changed_reading.after: Even a protected dwelling can be a misleadingly beautified enclave whose safety is noticed but attributed to the wrong source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revisiting the dwelling, rescue, and path branches yields a recovery loop: departure or rescue changes the place of belonging, and strenuous good action opens several guided routes.

activation_trace.role: The focus place-of-stability sense supplies the home condition that can either trap or shelter.
The focus action sense supplies the effort that converts relocation into practice.
The focus obstruction sense supplies the blockage that must be reversed.
The focus route sense supplies the field in which reopening can occur.
The prepared-place image supplies a received refuge after compromised habitation.
The rescue image supplies separation from danger and transition to a new ground.
The strenuous-effort image supplies the active cost of reopening direction.
The guidance image supplies the directional response to that effort.
The plural-route image expands the single blocked way into several accessible paths.
The good-action image aligns renewed movement with constructive practice.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from inherited or endangered habitation through prepared rooms and rescue-to-land, ending with striving, guidance, and plural paths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies changed dwelling, rescue, effort, guidance, and paths; I infer a home-to-path recovery loop that revises the focus's blockage without erasing its warning; an alternative is that the final guidance verse is a generic exhortation unrelated to the earlier spatial sequence.

changed_reading.before: Once diverted, the people remain enclosed by their inherited way of life.
changed_reading.after: Obstruction can be reversed through departure, rescue, and strenuous good work that opens multiple guided routes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because the Satan-root's tensile rope image is branch-distant from the ordinary agent reading; it remains anchored to Satan, works, and path-blocking, with the spider web supplying a visible entanglement analogy. Downstream prose should label it a material exploration, not a primary lexical interpretation.

activation_trace.role: The tensile-rope sense gives the named adversary a tethering rather than merely persuasive function.
The deliberate-work sense supplies the threads or practices into which people can be caught.
The repelling sense turns entanglement into inability to leave the route.
The path sense supplies the movement that the tether interrupts.
The fine-weaving creature supplies a delicate network that obstructs without looking like a wall.
The house image makes the network a shelter-like enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Satan redirects them through persuasion or temptation.
changed_reading.after: The attractive works can function as fine tethers, weaving people into a fragile shelter that prevents exit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because the dwelling-root is activated through a ship's steering apparatus rather than a house; it remains valid through the focus path and the later ship-to-land reversal. Downstream prose should present it as a nautical material analogy, not as the literal meaning of the historical dwellings.

activation_trace.role: The nautical stabilizer sense makes the focus dwelling-root an instrument for quieting or directing movement.
The focus obstruction sense supplies the danger of losing controlled direction.
The route sense supplies the course that requires stabilization.
The vessel-riding image supplies a moving environment in which control and refuge overlap.
The ship image supplies the material field for navigating between danger and land.
The divided-allegiance image supplies the post-landing return of misdirection.

changed_reading.before: Homes are static sites contrasted with later travel.
changed_reading.after: Settledness can also be a stabilizing control regime: rescue changes the ground, after which the old misdirection returns.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it crosses from the proper-name reading of ʿĀd into a non-dominant counting target; it remains anchored because that mapped target is supplied for the focus occurrence and the context supplies explicit durations and appointed terms. Downstream prose should mark it as philological exploration, not claim that the name literally means number.

activation_trace.role: The direct-name sense keeps the focus anchored in a named historical case.
The counted-time target recasts the named case as part of a repeatable temporal index.
The large-number image makes historical duration measurable.
The year image supplies a recurring unit for long habitation.
The appointed-term image gives the temporal series a bounded endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The named peoples are simply historical examples.
changed_reading.after: The named cases can be read as a countable recurrence in which long habitation and fixed terms make destruction comparable rather than anecdotal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because moral beautification is read through ecological bloom; it remains anchored by the focus adornment and work roots and by the context's rain-revived earth. Downstream prose should qualify it as a surface-versus-substrate analogy, not identify Satanic action with weather.

activation_trace.role: The beautifying-earth sense lets attractive appearance be imagined as a surface bloom.
The work sense supplies the humanly maintained substrate beneath that appearance.
The stable-place sense makes the surface condition belong to an inhabited environment.
The rain-and-plant image supplies visible vitality emerging over the earth.
The distraction image supplies the possibility that visible liveliness occupies attention while deeper orientation is neglected.

changed_reading.before: Beautification is an abstract moral appearance.
changed_reading.after: Beautification behaves like seasonal bloom on a settled surface: vivid vitality can cover a dead or misdirected substrate.

strongest_changes: مساكنهم shifts from passive ruins to an evidentiary and sometimes social or material interface.
زَيَّنَ ... فَصَدَّهُمْ becomes a valuation trap and public route blockage, not simple ignorance.
The path field expands from diversion and enclosure to water access, relocation, rescue, and finally plural guided paths.
The context preserves their recognition while showing that recognition may fail to govern action.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact paradox—visible settlements, beautified works, a blocked path, and prior discernment—supports coexisting cognitive, social, household, spatial, and material mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ primarily denotes optical acuity, moral insight, or an unresolved eye-heart split.
Whether the dwelling evidence is literal architecture or broader historical signs.
Whether Satanic agency should remain a personified agent or also name a recurring social and affective mechanism.
The rope, boat, water, counting, and ecological readings are exploratory analogies rather than primary lexical senses.
